timestamp_derivation: The committer date of the last CONTENT commit of this delivery (481df221), so the receipt cannot post-date the commit that introduces it; it is after the merge (31f0dfe1) this delivery is based on.
authorisation: Product-Owner mission of 2026-09-24: a substantial Hotel Admin UX and operations overhaul across seven areas (PMS connections and future multi-provider support, Internet packages / Service plans / Guest activity, Checkout grace, Vouchers, Portal settings as a designer, the Dashboard, and overall UX), delivered on the established daytime model: modify, targeted tests, commit, push, deploy to PRE-LIVE 172.21.60.25 under the standing PRE-LIVE deployment decision, verify, continue. The mission explicitly did NOT authorise changing the live Protel configuration, connecting PRE-LIVE to any new PMS provider, PMS posting or financial traffic, a database migration or schema decision, networking or topology changes, Guest activation or Go-Live.
what_was_delivered: PMS: one provider registry (internal/pmsprovider) that the four former allowlists now derive from; polled REST connectors for Mews, Apaleo and Oracle OPERA Cloud (internal/pmsrest, internal/pmsd/adapter_rest.go) implemented from their official documentation; the edged catalogue, provider-aware revision authoring, structured sealed credentials and a connection test; and a redesigned multi-provider PMS connections screen with an add-connection wizard. Internet packages, Service plans and a rebuilt Guest activity view from purchases rather than offer quotes. A redesigned Checkout grace screen. A rebuilt Vouchers workflow. Portal settings rebuilt as a designer with six templates, an allowlist HTML and CSS sanitiser shared by edged and portald, and a nonce-based Content-Security-Policy on the guest portal. A new Overview dashboard over a new report endpoint and an appliance-resources read path. One shared UI kit so the areas read as one product.
pms_verification_status: Protel FIAS is the only LIVE_PROVIDER_VERIFIED connector and its behaviour is unchanged: pinned by regression tests (identical allowlist membership, validation outcomes, payload bytes and fingerprint), by the pmsd PostgreSQL integration run (rc=0), and live. Mews, Apaleo and OPERA Cloud are AUTOMATED_CONTRACT_VERIFIED only: tested against deterministic fixtures shaped from the official documentation, never against a real provider, because none is available. The catalogue and the screens say so. OPERA or Fidelio over FIAS is deliberately NOT offered: the FIAS specification is not public and no documented profile difference could be built and contract-tested without touching the Protel path.
protel_continuity_across_the_pmsd_deploy: pmsd carries the live Protel link, so its restart was treated as the one delicate step. Before: CONNECTED, IN_SYNC, CONTINUOUS, room sign-in ready, 479 guests in house, nothing pending or awaiting review. pmsd was restarted at 20:16:12Z; a fresh full resync was published 37 seconds later with 479 records, and the link returned to CONNECTED / IN_SYNC / CONTINUOUS with room sign-in ready and nothing pending. Measured, not assumed: the 479 stay-event payloads written after the deploy carry exactly the same seven keys as the 500 before it and none carries a sharers key; and every resync that day logged vacant-room records skipped, with records plus skipped equal to 587 -- the property's room count -- before and after.
found_by_verifying_live: Defects the unit tests did not catch, each found by driving the deployed build on PRE-LIVE and each fixed with a regression test: tables widened the whole page on a phone (the sr-only header label escaped an unpositioned scroll container); a package with no published configuration was listed as Active and its configuration requested on every load; the Overview listed a never-configured PMS connection by the name a setup script gave it; the voucher result said '1 vouchers issued'; the portal designer kept sending autosaves the server had already refused; and the guest portal requested a default background photo that no appliance ships, on every guest page load.
not_exercised_because_controlled: No PMS configuration was changed and no new PMS provider was contacted; Mews, Apaleo and OPERA Cloud were never connected. No PMS posting or financial traffic. No migration or schema change. No networking change. No guest activation. The published guest-portal design and the Checkout grace policy were NOT changed by verification: publishing was exercised only up to a refused step-up (wrong password, HTTP 401) and the designer was verified by discarding; both were confirmed unchanged afterwards. One voucher card was issued and then cancelled on purpose to verify the workflow the operator reported broken; issuing a card grants nothing by itself, since the activation step stays dark under D41.
decisions_this_raises_and_does_not_take: (1) DELETING an Internet package or Service plan needs a database change (the revision rows are immutable by trigger, svc_edged holds no DELETE grant, and eight foreign keys reference package revisions with no ON DELETE). The screens explain this and offer Disable instead; a real delete needs a Product-Owner decision on a migration. (2) PRE-LIVE carries two scaffold rows written by an earlier validation script -- a never-configured PMS connection and an active package with no configuration. The screens now present both truthfully, but removing or retiring them is a change to live configuration data and is left for the Product Owner.
